Dodge & Cox Has Cut Sanofi (SNY) Stake as Share Price Declined; As Canadian Pac Ry LTD (CP) Market Value Declined, Egerton Capital Uk Llp Has Increased Stake by $76.42 Million
May 20, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Dodge & Cox decreased its stake in Sanofi (SNY) by 0.17% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Dodge & Cox sold 102,727 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.41% with the market. The institutional investor held 62.08 million shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $2.67 billion, down from 62.18 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Dodge & Cox who had been investing in Sanofi for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $95.88B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.03% or $0.01 $38.88. About 1.30M shares traded or 11.38% up from the average. Sanofi (NYSE:SNY) has declined 13.31% downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.86% the S&P500.
John Armitage increased its stake in Canadian Pac Ry Ltd (CP) by 37.64% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Egerton Capital Uk Llp bought 419,905 shares as the company’s stock declined 4.52% with the market. The hedge fund run by John Armitage held 1.54 million shares of the railroads company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $280.65M, up from 1.12M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Egerton Capital Uk Llp who had been investing in Canadian Pac Ry Ltd for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $26.24B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.96% or $1.77 $182.25. About 846,381 shares traded or 85.51% up from the average. Canadian Pacific Railway Limited (NYSE:CP) has risen 19.42% uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.87% the S&P500.
